## Technical Stack & Expertise

## Primary Projects & Crafts
- **Phisguard App** (https://sagnik-wtf.vercel.app/craft): Mobile & web anti-phishing security companion app protecting users from real-time fraudulent threats.
- **Doctor Booking App** (https://sagnik-wtf.vercel.app/craft): Healthcare scheduling platform with AI-driven doctor appointment matching.
- **ScreenREC** (https://sagnik-wtf.vercel.app/craft): Lightweight browser-based screen recording utility.
- **Linkees** (https://sagnik-wtf.vercel.app/craft): Modern bio link aggregation platform.
